name: [voice-demo] The agent is too slow to answer a phone call
message:
The 95th-percentile agent turn is taking more than four seconds, which on a voice channel is dead air the caller cannot interrupt.

This fires for provider problems, not network ones: a lossy network degrades the transcript but does not slow the model down. Check whether the network panels are clean — if they are, this is the provider, and `voice.stt.first_partial_ms` will usually be elevated with it.

A turn that calls a tool legitimately costs two model round trips, so a jump to roughly double the normal figure is tool use rather than a sick provider. The per-round spans in Agent Observability distinguish the two.

This monitor is what the scripted demo's provider-degraded beat is built to trip.

@slack-voice-demo
